# T1: the map teacher on HUMAN states (generated by dag.py t1)

Human states: the recorded log of the 719 non-held curated train scenes, every 0.5 s with speed >= 2.0 m/s and a full 4 s future. Teacher path from the human pose; label points at the human's own arc lengths (the T1 analogue of the student's served plan). Error = the human's future point minus the teacher point at the same time, along the teacher path's left normal.

Classes: turn = the human turns >= 30 deg in 4 s; lane-change = D1's shape (v > 5 m/s, |y4| > 2.5 m, |yaw4| < 12 deg in the human's frame; the teacher keeps the route lane, so these are expected to differ); other = the rest.
